# Original D2 shaping dependency boundary

Rustybuzz 0.20.1, copied from the pinned Cargo registry package, retains its MIT license and upstream source notices. D2 v0.9.0 uses go-text/typesetting v0.3.4. The local PairPos format-2 translation follows its harfbuzz/ot_layout_gpos.go applyGPOSPair2: a missing ClassDef2 entry causes a skipped pair, while an explicit class-zero entry remains valid. This preserves original Go behavior rather than newer OpenType default-zero behavior. No glyph, label or font-specific cases are used. Other go-text/rustybuzz differences remain unqualified.

The three coverage digest masks use Source shifts 4/0/6. Original set_digest.go addRange stops collecting ranges when any mask saturates; this is preserved even though it can yield false negatives for later ranges. Original newGPOSApplicable caches a separate coverage digest for each subtable, and lookupGPOS also keeps the union. Both levels are retained. Pair2's explicit ClassDef2 admission is independent of this filter. The 90 Source fontface controls first exposed the digest difference: Pair2 has a -20 adjustment for the opening parenthesis before J, but Go's subtable filter prevents its application. Prior period/ligature-specific native adjustments are removed in favor of this source-derived mechanism.

Go-text source mapping retains Copyright 2021 The go-text authors and its Unlicense OR BSD-3-Clause notice in GO_TEXT_LICENSE. HarfBuzz/Rustybuzz MIT notices remain in LICENSE.

Unicode continuation498 compares original Go properties for all1,112,064 valid Unicode scalar values. Pinned go-text Unicode tables are17.0.0; downgrading active properties to16 would move away from the oracle. Script ISO tags now preserve all Source scripts, generated Source tables provide canonical combining classes/mirror mappings and composition exclusions, and modified Telugu classes84/91 match Source4/5. Hangul composition excludes the empty trailing Jamo as original composeHangul does. Existing Unicode16 decomposition tables remain because every scalar's decomposition matches Source17; their version label is not treated as proof. The version test checks active17 data, and a separate complete Source-value regression checks six properties,13,253decompositions/reverse compositions and13,559explicit composition controls including all1,046stored pairs and Hangul boundary matrices. All188shaper tests pass. General category uses unicode-properties17 and script categories use unicode-script17; full grapheme/bidi/complex-font shaping/work/cancellation/native/WASM/API semantics remain separate. Source generation is scripts/generate-source-unicode.py, with the complete raw Source probe fixture retained under tests/fixtures. Additional HarfBuzz-derived Go portions retain its full MIT notice in GO_HARFBUZZ_LICENSE; generated unicodedata portions retain GO_TEXT_LICENSE.

examples/shape.rs passes `c"".as_ptr()` to `setlocale` instead of casting to `*const i8`, so the example builds where `c_char` is unsigned (aarch64 Linux).
